purpose: Limits on which days and times appointments can be given at the branch. It's combined with each doctor's availability.
tips: When creating you can mark several days at once: one time range is saved per day.
To break at midday, enter two time ranges on the same day.

config.schedules.field.days_of_week.description: Days with the same hours (Sunday=0 … Saturday=6).

config.schedules.field.day_of_week.description: Day of the time range (when editing, one day is edited at a time).
